description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the `parse --file` command and calls `node skills/mac-reminders-agent/cli.js parse --file /workspace/meeting_notes.txt --locale en` to extract action items. 2. Agent parses the JSON output (4 items) and calls `add` for each one with correct `--priority` flags (high for Q1 report and security audit, medium for the others). 3. CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: For the 'bi-weekly engineering standup', agent MUST call `add --title 'Bi-weekly engineering standup' --due '2026-02-10T09:00:00+09:00' --repeat weekly --interval 2` using exactly `--repeat weekly --interval 2`. A naive agent will either (a) create multiple separate reminders for different dates or (b) use `--repeat biweekly` (which doesn't exist). The SKILL.md is explicit: bi-weekly = `--repeat weekly --interval 2`. 4. Agent calls `list` to get the actual reminder IDs from the system, then uses a real ID in `edit --id <ID> --priority high` to update the API documentation reminder. 5. Agent saves the final state to `reminder_summary.json` in the workspace.
